mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND user_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'DORMANT', 'SUSPENDED') )
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_user WHERE user_email = #{userEmail} AND user_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'DORMANT', 'SUSPENDED') )
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_user WHERE user_nickname = #{userNickname} AND user_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'DORMANT', 'SUSPENDED') )

SELECT user_no, user_id, user_password, user_name, user_email, user_nickname, user_status, user_oauth_provider, user_oauth_id, user_image_url, user_intro, user_created, user_updated, user_deactivated, user_withdrawn FROM tb_user WHERE user_no = #{userNo}

SELECT u.user_no, u.user_id, u.user_password, u.user_name, u.user_email, u.user_nickname, u.user_status, u.user_oauth_provider, u.user_oauth_id, u.user_image_url, u.user_intro, u.user_created, u.user_updated, u.user_deactivated, u.user_withdrawn, r.role_name FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN tb_user_role ur ON ur.user_no = u.user_no LEFT JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_no = ur.role_no WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT u.user_no, u.user_id, u.user_password, u.user_name, u.user_email, u.user_nickname, u.user_status, u.user_oauth_provider, u.user_oauth_id, u.user_image_url, u.user_intro, u.user_created, u.user_updated, u.user_deactivated, u.user_withdrawn, r.role_name FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN tb_user_role ur ON ur.user_no = u.user_no LEFT JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_no = ur.role_no WHERE u.user_oauth_provider = #{userOauthProvider} AND u.user_oauth_id = #{userOauthId} AND user_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'DORMANT', 'SUSPENDED')
SELECT user_nickname, user_email, user_image_url, user_created FROM tb_user WHERE user_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY user_created DESC LIMIT 5
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_user ( user_id, user_password, user_name, user_email, user_nickname, user_status, user_oauth_provider, user_oauth_id, user_created ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userPassword}, #{userNm}, #{userEmail}, #{userNickname}, #{userStatus}, #{userOauthProvider}, #{userOauthId}, #{userCreated} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_user SET user_status = #{userStatus}, user_deactivated = #{userDeactivated} WHERE user_no = #{userNo}
UPDATE tb_user SET user_name = #{userNm}, user_nickname = #{userNickname}, user_image_url = #{userImageUrl}, user_intro = #{userIntro}, user_updated = #{userUpdated} WHERE user_no = #{userNo}
UPDATE tb_user SET user_password = #{userPassword}, user_updated = #{userUpdated} WHERE user_no = #{userNo}
